title: Effects of activating agent and pyrolysis temperature on the pore structure and adsorption performance of sweet potato vine-based activated carbon
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18232-18241
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01057A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wei Wei, Na Ren
Activated carbon derived from sweet potato vine exhibits a high surface area and strong adsorption capacity for methylene blue, driven by electrostatic interactions, hydrogen bonding, pore filling, π–π interactions, and hydrophobic interactions.
